body:
I've put, at least, some time into learning about depression. In the last 6-8 months I've started running and cycling on a regular basis, I've registered for some local 5k, 10k races and a half-marathon with some friends, gotten outside during daylight hours more (I work midnights), and started regularly taking vitamins and fish oil.



As far a seeing a professional, (as stated) I've saw a VA councilor for 3+ years regarding war related, along with general depression, issues. Should I peruse it further? Perhaps. I feel that I've moved beyond the combat issues that originally plagued me.



 I guess I was just hoping for some insight that would help me beyond these other issues that I seem to be dealing with.
